description: Formal offline Agent with structured state, Buying/Browsing routing, hybrid BM25 retrieval, local constraint ranking, guarded Top-10 reranking, and SAFE question policy.
known_risks: SAFE mode preserves the fixed applied question order; candidate-aware selection is observational only in SHADOW mode and active only in DYNAMIC mode.
The current generic diagnostic trace emphasizes the guarded legacy routes and does not yet expose every formal retrieval and ranker feature.
The public 200-session result must not be treated as an unbiased hidden-set estimate.
name: integrated_guarded_rerank_safe
